about_the_game:
Step into a world of pixelated carnage with Terrifier: The ARTcade Game, a gory retro fighting beat 'em up packed with intense action, dark humor, and tons of fun! Inspired by the classic beat 'em up games of the 80s and 90s.

The game captures the essence of the Terrifier movies with spectacular hand-drawn art and fluid animations that showcase the action with striking grotesqueness. In this demo, you will be able to go through a complete level, with different paths to explore and enemies to defeat. Get ready for an intense boss fight that will test your skills.

  • Gorgeous Pixel Art & Animation: The game captures the essence of the Terrifier films with bright, cartoonish pixel art and fluid animations that vividly depict the gruesome action.

  • Multiplayer Mayhem: Team up with up to 2 players for a local co-op experience of total mayhem.

  • Bloody Arsenal of Weapons: From chainsaws to cleavers, pick up a variety of weapons to turn your enemies into bloody pulp.

  • Synthwave/retro music: Relive the golden age of gaming with a glorious chiptune soundtrack that perfectly complements the retro aesthetic.

  • Over-the-Top Attacks & Finishers: Enjoy hilarious and gory attacks that make every fight as entertaining as it is brutal. The finishing moves are guaranteed to leave a gory delight impression!

  • Multiple Game Modes: Enjoy the arcade mode, among the future 6 different game modes you will find in the final product.

Are you ready to embrace the madness and become the ultimate terror? Jump into Terrifier: The ARTcade Game, and let the carnage begin!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Core i5 | AMD FX 2.4Ghz
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Direct X compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: To play in multiplayer it is necessary to have several controllers, it is not possible to play with keyboard and mouse.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Core i5 | AMD FX 2.4Ghz
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: To play in multiplayer it is necessary to have several controllers, it is not possible to play with keyboard and mouse.
